name: Super 8
description: Home-movie Super 8: heavy grain and weave, vignette, warm cast, dust specks, 4:3.
rationale: Super 8 gate is 5.79 mm wide — huge relative grain (the same dye clouds on a quarter of 16mm's area), so grain size/amount are roughly double 16mm's. Cheap zoom optics vignette visibly. Kodachrome/Ektachrome home stock plus tungsten shooting reads warm. Projection dust and emulsion scratches appear as sparse bright/dark specks that live for a single frame — sparse thresholded animated noise. Registration in cartridge cameras was poor: strong gate weave.
